name: Spectrum
fit: Creative tools with separate mobile and desktop scales.
principles: Writing is part of the system: voice, grammar, inclusivity, and error messages.
typography: Separate type scales for mobile and desktop. Mobile components are 25% larger than desktop, a 1:1.25 ratio.
shape: Border widths stay consistent across components.
adapt: Keep the mobile and desktop scales and the consistent border width. Open the source before using a color, space, or shadow. Replace Adobe's brand.
